name: Implementation Specification 1
definition: Identifies the implementation specification to which the ISO 20022 message conforms.

Registry.name: Registry
Registry.definition: Name of the implementation specification registry in which the implementation specification of the ISO 20022 message is maintained.|For example, "MyStandards".

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: Identifier which unambiguously identifies, within the implementation specification registry, the implementation specification to which the ISO 20022 message is compliant. This can be done via a URN. It can also contain a version number or date.|For instance, "2018-01-01 – Version 2" or "urn:uuid:6e8bc430-9c3a-11d9-9669-0800200c9a66".
